==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) Aarya Munro and Duck Dino fight for the chance to join the crew. (Aarya Munro first appeared in a dream on 10/31/2025.) (Duck Dino first appeared in a dream on 10/30/2025.) (Both characters in their initial appearances were interested in joining the team. This dream pits them against each other to determine their worthiness relative to one another.) I learn both of their motivations. (Aarya Munro is a multiversal superhero, so she already does what our team does. She is looking for a crew and we fit the bill.) (Duck Dino believes in Valhalla and wants to die a warrior's death in order to ascend. She believes that fighting alongside us will eventually lead to the heroic death she is hoping for.) I decide they can both act as reserve members. (I feel like there is plenty of space within Leon for a huge team, but for now I feel like that space is better used as a home for the main team. If we need the reserves we can call them in, but otherwise they don't need to literally live on the ship with us.)
